name: craig-personal-todo
description: Craig's Trello-backed personal todo workflow for desktop and mobile ChatGPT Work. Defaults to Craig's personal Gmail when personal task work needs email.

interface.shortDescription: Manage Craig's Trello Personal Todo board.
interface.longDescription: Read, prioritise and update Craig's personal todo system using the Trello Personal Todo board as the source of truth across desktop and mobile ChatGPT Work. When personal todo work needs email, use Craig's personal Gmail by default unless another account is explicitly requested.
defaultPrompt: Use $manage-personal-tasks to tell me what to do next from my Trello Personal Todo board.
Use $manage-personal-tasks to add, update, move or complete a personal todo card.
Use $manage-personal-tasks to review my Today / Now, This Week and Waiting tasks.
Use $manage-personal-tasks with my personal Gmail by default when a personal todo requires email context.
